properties.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued November 25 at 9:12PM EST until November 27 at 3:00AM EST by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
properties.description:
* WHAT...One to two feet of inundation above ground level
expected in low lying areas due to tidal flooding.

* WHERE...Shoreline in the District of Columbia, Arlington
County, and the City of Alexandria.

* WHEN...From 3 PM Thursday to 3 AM EST Friday, especially
around the time of high tide.

* IMPACTS...Flooding is expected at the DC seafood market and in
portions of East Potomac Park. Water is expected to cover the
boardwalk at Washington Harbour. An increasing number of
streets and parks are flooded in Alexandria. Access to
Daingerfield Island is cut off.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Tides up to 4 feet above normal. The next
high tide at Alexandria is at 9:06 AM and 9:18 PM. The next high
tide at Washington Channel is at 8:48 AM and 9:00 PM.
properties.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.

properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 25 at 8:22PM EST until November 26 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
properties.description:
* WHAT...East to northeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts around 55
mph expected.

* WHERE...District of Columbia as well as the Washington and
Baltimore Metropolitan areas into north-central Maryland, northern
Virginia as well as the northern Shenandoah Valley, the eastern
Panhandle of West Virginia as well as portions of the Potomac
Highlands in West Virginia.

* WHEN...From 4 AM to 7 PM EST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Trees
could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Anyone travelling Thursday should pay close
attention to the latest conditions. Downed trees combined with
heavy rain may make travel dangerous at times.
properties.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
